text: Horizontal centering tract common layout issue across 6. render/scene rotational asymmetry (two anatomy halves differ: left bundle 5577 streamlines, right 2397; right half comes consistently denser ⇒ right-hemisphere-heavier every render, e.g. LR occupancy ratio ~0.94–0.99). text: 30 streamlines per side (nL = 30, nR = 30). Downsampling done densest areas top area (crown / uppermost part bundle), sparse fan stays even near apex.
